missions.name: Artemis Supply Run
missions.shortDescription: Resupply the south pole base with food, equipment, and spare parts.
missions.description: A high-priority logistics mission delivering 12 metric tons of consumables and spare life-support components to Artemis Base Camp. The crew of four will conduct a 14-day surface stay to unload cargo and perform routine habitat interface checks before returning to lunar orbit.

missions.name: Lunar Habitat Expansion
missions.shortDescription: Deploy two modular habitat units and connect them to the main dome.
missions.description: Engineering mission to expand permanent living quarters at Shackleton Rim. Six specialists will install prefabricated modules, extend power and water lines, and commission new airlock systems. Completion will raise base capacity from 12 to 20 personnel.

missions.name: Helium-3 Extraction
missions.shortDescription: Pilot-scale mining of helium-3 from polar regolith.
missions.description: Critical-path energy mission testing in-situ extraction of helium-3 for future fusion research. An eight-person crew operates mobile harvesters across a 4 km² survey zone. Current operations are under elevated scrutiny after a dust-filter pressure anomaly on 2026-04-28.

missions.name: Orbital Relay Maintenance
missions.shortDescription: Replace failing transponders on the L1 communications relay.
missions.description: Completed maintenance sortie to the Earth–Moon L1 relay station. Two technicians replaced three degraded S-band transponders and recalibrated the optical downlink. Downtime was limited to 47 minutes and nominal bandwidth was restored ahead of schedule.

missions.name: Water Reserve Transport
missions.shortDescription: Haul 8,000 L of recycled and imported water to storage tanks.
missions.description: Planned resupply run addressing projected summer consumption spike. Five crew members will transfer water ice from the polar cache to main storage, verify purification loop integrity, and update reserves to 45-day autonomy targets.

missions.name: Solar Array Inspection
missions.shortDescription: Inspect and clean primary solar arrays after micrometeorite season.
missions.description: Post-storm inspection of the base's 2.4 MW solar farm. Three technicians found minor panel abrasions on sectors C and D, performed electrostatic cleaning, and confirmed output within 98% of design spec. No array replacements required.

missions.name: Emergency Medical Delivery
missions.shortDescription: Rush critical pharmaceuticals and surgical supplies to the medical bay.
missions.description: Urgent two-person flight launched after a compound fracture during excavation work. Crew is delivering autologous tissue kits, broad-spectrum antibiotics, and a portable ultrasound unit. ETA to base landing pad: six hours from launch.

missions.name: Deep Crater Survey
missions.shortDescription: Map subsurface ice deposits in unexplored south polar crater.
missions.description: Low-priority science mission to survey Faustini crater using ground-penetrating radar and core sampling. Four geologists will spend ten days on the rim cataloguing ice layer depth and regolith composition for long-term resource planning.
